13. INDUCTION OF LABOUR: IOL

-1/5 pregnancies need IOL
-2/3 give birth without intervention
-15% need AVB
-22% end up in C/S
323.Most women go into labour by 42 weeks
324.@ 38 weeks all women should be offered information regarding

1. Risk of pregnancies that last longer than 42 weeks.

2. Expectant management

3. Membranes stripping

-Method
-benefits of spontaneous labour
-Uncomfortable, pain
-Possible bleeding

4. IOL between 41 – 42 weeks

Information giving before IOL:

1. Reason

2. When, where, how

3. Support, pain relief

4. Alternative to IOL

5. Risk/ Benefits of IOL

6. what if IOL fails

7. prolong pregnancy IOL between 41 – 42 weeks exact timing according to patient’s wishes patient who decline => after 42 weeks

CTG + Amniotic Fluid => twice/ week

⇨PPROM
-Before 37 weeks expectant management, to prolong till 37 weeks. In case of fetomaternal indications offer IOL
⇨PROM => 24 hours after ROM offer IOL
⇨Previous CS – PG E2/ expectant according to women wishes, explain risk of rupture and emergency CS
⇨Maternal request @ or after 40 weeks => under special conditions
⇨Breech – Not recommended
⇨Severe IUGR + compromise NR
⇨History of precipitated labor – not routinely offered.
⇨IUD

Patient physically Offer a choice of

well expectant/ IOL by

325.No infection mifepristone, FPG E2
326.No bleeding or misoprostol.

 

Unwell

+ bleeding + infection IOL

Ruptured management

 

 

IUD + previous

CS => risk of rupture, reduce dose of MISO

⇨Fetal macrosomia => Discuss

Methods:

327.Sweeping of Membranes = Adjunct to IOL
-primigravida = 40 – 41weeks
-Multigravida = 41 weeks
-additional sweeping can be done if patient don’t go into labor.
328.Bishop = > 8 => Favorable
329.MISO, MEFI => IUD only
330.PG E2
-Tablets – 3mg 6 hourly -
-GEL – 2mg 2 doses.
-Pessary – 20mg => 24 hours – 1 dose
331.Amniotomy + synto => only if risk of hyper stimulation

 

 

IOL @ older women:

Age @ delivery beyond 35 years ed from 8 – 20% and @ 40 years 1.2 – 3.6%
